currentParagraphText: “You have my word that I will not attack you,” the Sovereign said. “Even if you attack me first. I do want you to know that while you may hold reservations, so do I. But be aware that my involvement in this fight is not an invitation to turn your weapons toward me in the event of your victory.”

finalResult.nextParagraphText: “Fine,” Jake waved off the B-grade. He would have liked to still fight the Sovereign, but he had to accept it wasn’t going to happen. Instead, he would have to find satisfaction in an impromptu team-up with a former enemy... though in truth, he didn’t really plan on making it a real team-up.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “Not gonna lie and say I don’t have some serious reservations... but sure,” Jake agreed to team up with the bird that had tried to kill him the last time they’d met.
